name: First five

sprites.name: Delta Charizard
sprites.note: Back only; the front is as it was. Head: now built on official Charizard's own back head, so it faces at the same angle: seen from behind, muzzle down and to the right, a small eye, the mouth open. It has Delta Charizard's tones and its one swept horn. Spine: the ribcage is the same width either side of it now, and it runs from the neck straight to the root of the tail. Tail: it leaves the base of the spine and stays joined there and at each joint while it swings; the flame stays on its tip. Look back still turns Insurgence's side-on head toward the trainer for about three seconds.

note: Fourteenth look. Delta Charizard's back: the head at Charizard's angle, an even spine, the tail joined at its root. The front is unchanged.
